Pañcaślokī

1
यत्सत्यम् तु मया कृतम् मम विभो कृत्यम् तु नातः परम् यन्मन्मानसमेशपादकमले भक्त्या मधैवार्पितम्
सर्वस्वंह्यत एवमेतदितरनास्त्येव जानाम्यत स्त्यक्त्वा क्षिप्रमनाथनाथ करुणासिन्धो प्रसनो भव
yatsatyaṃ tu mayā kṛtaṃ mama vibho kṛtyaṃ tu nātaḥ paraṃ yanmanmānasameśapādakamale bhaktyā madhaivārpitam‌ |
sarvasvaṃhyata evametaditaranāstyeva jānāmyata- styaktvā kṣipramanāthanātha karuṇāsindho prasano bhava ||
Whatever I have truly done, O Lord — no duty of mine goes beyond this: my pride, laid at Your lotus feet with devotion. This is my all; I know there is nothing other. So, casting all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, O ocean of compassion — be pleased with me!

2
महेश त्वदद्वारि स्फुरतु रुचिरा वागतितराम् म॑भेषा निर्दोषम् जय जय महेशेति सततम्
शिवा सैषा वाणी भवतु शिवदा मह्यमनिशम् महेशानाथम् माम् शरणद सनाथम् कुरू विभो
maheśa tvadadvāri sphuratu rucirā vāgatitarāṃ ma̭bheṣā nirdoṣaṃ jaya jaya maheśeti satatam‌ |
śivā saiṣā vāṇī bhavatu śivadā mahyamaniśaṃ maheśānāthaṃ māṃ śaraṇada sanāthaṃ kurū vibho ||
O Maheśa, at Your door let this charming speech of mine flash forth, exceeding all: 'Victory, victory to Maheśa!' — faultless, unceasing. Let this very speech, auspicious, be bliss-giving to me forever. O Lord, O giver of refuge, make me — whose protector is Maheśa — possessed of a protector!
studio chant · gadya · align 0.0
3
ब्रूषे नोत्तरमड्ग पश्यसि न मासेतादुशम् दु खितम् विज्ञपि बहुधा कृताम् न शृणुषे नायासि मनमानसे
संसारार्णवगर्तमध्यपतितम् प्रायेण नालम्बसे वाकचक्षः श्रवणाइप्रिपाणिरहितम् त्वामाह सत्यम् श्रुतिः
brūṣe nottaramaḍga paśyasi na māsetāduśaṃ du khitaṃ vijñapi bahudhā kṛtāṃ na śṛṇuṣe nāyāsi manamānase |
saṃsārārṇavagartamadhyapatitaṃ prāyeṇa nālambase vākacakṣaḥ śravaṇāipripāṇirahitaṃ tvāmāha satyaṃ śrutiḥ ||
You speak not, O best-limbed one; You look not upon me, wretched as I am. My entreaty, made in many ways, You hear not; You come not into my mind. Fallen into the pit amid transmigration's ocean, I am mostly left unsupported — yet scripture truly declares You devoid of speech, sight, hearing, feet and the like!

4
गुरोर्वाक्याद् युक्तिप्रचयरचनोन्मार्जनवशात् समाश्वासाच्छास् प्रति समुचिताद्वापि कथितम्
विलीने शङ्काभे हृदयगगनोद्भासि महसः प्रभोः सूर्यस्येव स्पृशतु चरणान् ध्वान्तजयिनः
gurorvākyād‌ yuktipracayaracanonmārjanavaśāt‌ samāśvāsācchās prati samucitādvāpi kathitam‌ |
vilīne śaṅkābhe hṛdayagaganodbhāsi mahasaḥ prabhoḥ sūryasyeva spṛśatu caraṇān‌ dhvāntajayinaḥ ||
From the guru's word — by the force that wipes away the fabric of heaped-up reasonings — and from the assurance told, fittingly, out of regard for scripture: when the cloud of doubt has dissolved, let me touch the feet of the Lord, whose splendor shines in the sky of the heart — like the sun, the conqueror of darkness.
studio chant · gadya · align 0.0
5
यातस्त्वत्सहवासतो बहुतरः कालो वतासिन् क्षणे कि कि वान कृतम् त्वया वरगुरूपासानिमित्तेन मे
वारम् वारमहम् पुनर्निरूपमाम् दिव्यम् भुवम् प्रासुव त्कायस्त्वाम् किल विस्मरामि यदतः स्थेयम् न भूयस्त्वया
yātastvatsahavāsato bahutaraḥ kālo vatāsin‌ kṣaṇe ki ki vāna kṛtaṃ tvayā varagurūpāsānimittena me |
vāraṃ vāramahaṃ punarnirūpamāṃ divyaṃ bhuvaṃ prāsuva- tkāyastvāṃ kila vismarāmi yadataḥ stheyaṃ na bhūyastvayā ||
Much time dwelling with You has passed — alas, in this very moment! What, what has not been done by You for me, for the sake of serving the excellent guru! Again and again I, whose body has attained the incomparable divine plane — yet indeed I forget You. Therefore, by You, let there be no further staying-away!
